scorecard.promise: Tanishq new store additions target 35 to 40 for FY26
scorecard.quote: purely from new stores on Tanishq, I think 35 to 40 is a reasonable range to expect. 40 is the target.
scorecard.outcome: No specific total Tanishq store addition count provided in later reported call summaries.

scorecard.promise: Eyecare growth outlook expected to close FY26 between 13% to 14%
scorecard.quote: we believe that we should be closing this year at a slightly higher number than what you are seeing, anywhere between 13% to 14%.
scorecard.outcome: Feb 2026 call reports domestic growth of 17.5% and omnichannel growth of 11%, but full-year consolidated Eyecare growth is not specified.

scorecard.promise: Eyewear volume growth estimated around 8% to 10%
scorecard.quote: So from a volume growth standpoint, it is more or less within our zone. This is what we have estimated, around an 8% to 10% growth.
scorecard.outcome: Reported volume growth reached close to 8%.

scorecard.promise: Watches business margins to revert to 15%-16% over 1 to 2 years
scorecard.quote: mid-teen is a good number to aim for, 15% to 16% for the business, at least in the 1-year, 2-year time frame.
scorecard.outcome: Target timeframe of 1 to 2 years has not yet elapsed.

scorecard.promise: Jewellery business margin center of gravity around 11% for full year
scorecard.quote: more of 11% being the center of gravity for jewellery business margin, we would be around that plus/minus something can happen.
scorecard.outcome: Titan Jewellery normalized margin achieved 11.1% (customs adjusted) and 11.7% (MTM/customs adjusted) in Q2 FY27.

scorecard.promise: Anchor margin target at around 11% for FY27
scorecard.quote: I think we still, Mihir, would like to anchor our margin target at around 11%.
scorecard.outcome: Sep 2026 (Q2 FY27) consolidated operating margin reached 14.0%. Titan Jewellery normalized margin reported at 11.1%.

scorecard.promise: CaratLane EBIT margin to inch towards double-digits over next couple of years
scorecard.quote: gradually, CaratLane with the scale will start inching towards double-digit EBIT margin... they would stay there, low double-digit margin EBIT profile.
scorecard.outcome: CaratLane EBIT margin was 9.6% in Q1 FY27 and dropped to 6.5% in Q2 FY27.
scorecard.evidence_source: Aug 2026 and Nov 2026 calls reported data

scorecard.promise: Target 15% to 20% jewellery growth over 3 to 5 year horizon
scorecard.quote: This is the medium to three to five-year horizon if you want to look at. This is the growth rate we are expecting.
scorecard.outcome: Multi-year horizon is ongoing; Q2 FY27 YoY revenue growth was 10.0%.

credibility.summary: Management consistently achieves stated margin targets around 11% for Jewellery and delivers on volume goals while setting realistic multi-year growth targets.

narrative_vs_numbers: Management anchored Jewellery margin at 11%, aligned with reported normalized margins of 11.1% and 11.7% in Q2 FY27.
Reported Eyewear volume growth of close to 8% matched guidance of 8% to 10% volume growth.
CaratLane EBIT margin narrative emphasized inching towards double digits, but actual margin dropped to 6.5% in Q2 FY27.

calls.tone: Confident yet cautious due to gold price volatility and rising competitive intensity.
